patches.value: For every t>0, e(·,t) is Lebesgue integrable. For every t>0 there exist a finite closed interval J=[s₀,s₁]⊂(0,∞) with s₀<t<s₁ and a compact set C⊂ℝⁿ such that, for every s∈J and x∉C, u(x,s)=q, ∂_s u(x,s)=0, and ∂_{x_j}u(x,s)=0 for every j∈Fin n; for every s∈J, the maps x↦u_t(x,s), x↦∂_{x_j}u(x,s), x↦e(x,s), and x↦e_t(x,s) are continuous on ℝⁿ and vanish for every x∉C, for each j∈Fin n. The ambient measurable space on ℝⁿ is the Borel σ-algebra generated by its Euclidean topology, and Lebesgue measure μ satisfies μ(K)<∞ for every compact K⊂ℝⁿ.
N001 supplies ℝⁿ with its Euclidean topology and Borel measurable space.
N001 states that Euclidean opens are Borel measurable.
N001 directly states that every compact subset of ℝⁿ has finite Lebesgue measure.
